## Area of Need
What specific component, integration, or architecture requires community contribution?
- [ ] Connectors & Civic Data Ingestion (e.g., CKAN, Socrata, Eurostat)
- [ ] Geospatial Visualizations & GeoJSON processing
- [ ] AI Providers (e.g., Anthropic, Ollama, HuggingFace embeddings)
- [ ] DuckDB Query Optimization & Analytical Functions
- [ ] Frontend Accessibility, Responsive UI, & UX Design
- [ ] Documentation, Tutorials, & Case Studies

## Problem Statement
Detailed description of the problem or feature that requires assistance.

## Ideal Skillset
- Languages: [e.g. Python, TypeScript, SQL]
- Frameworks/Libraries: [e.g. FastAPI, Next.js, DuckDB, Leaflet, Qdrant]
- Domain Knowledge: [e.g. civic open data formats, GIS, vector retrieval]

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Code follows existing architectural patterns and clean abstractions
- [ ] Complete unit/integration tests added and passing
- [ ] Documentation updated in `docs/`
- [ ] CI checks pass cleanly
